title: Shabbos at Toldos Avraham Yitzchak
body: Thousands of chassidim gathered in Yerushalayim's Meah Shearim for a historic Shabbos marking 29 years since a momentous day in the life of the Toldos Avraham Yitzchak chassidus.

title: Yeshiva Bochurim Welcome Event
body: Thousands gathered in Bnei Brak's Kiryat Nadvorna for a mass reception welcoming detained yeshiva bochurim, as leading gedolim delivered powerful speeches.
